Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the Super Over shootout. The Proteas seem angry with themselves and don't even take a breather as they quickly head back onto the field of play. The officials are working things out with the teams and for now, it will be Azmatullah Omarzai and Rahmanullah Gurbaz to come out to bat for Afghanistan. The pressure is on South Africa as they keep waiting in the heat for the game to resume. Lungi Ngidi has the ball in hand and it will be Azmat to face the first ball. Let's go...
... Super Over ...

An all-time classic -  Can you believe what just happened out there? The game has swung like a pendulum and at the end of 40 overs, we still don't have a winner. Noor Ahmad has managed to take Afghanistan on level terms with the Proteas and we will now head into a Super Over shootout. Afghanistan will bat first. Let's head into overtime...

OUT! RUN OUT! Lost for words.... We have a SUPER OVER! Fuller delivery, around off, Noor Ahmad strokes it wide of long off where Marco Jansen runs across and sweeps it off. Easy two but maybe there is some tiredness in the batter's leg. Marco Jansen throws it to Rabada, Fazalhaq Farooqi struggles but puts in a solid dive to get to the non-striker's end. Kagiso Rabada holds his nerves as he picks up the throw, a touch out of his reach but flicks the bails off quickly. The replay loads - Fazalhaq Farooqi has his bat in the air.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 19.4: Kagiso Rabada to Noor Ahmad, OUT! run out (Marco Jansen / Kagiso Rabada).

Commentary.Commentary: More drama! A run-out review on the deciding ball. This is so close but Kagiso Rabada has redeemed himself. The bails are off and the bat is in the air. OUT comes up on the big screen.

NO BALL AGAIN! Kagiso Rabada, what are you doing? This is unlike this speedster. He is clearly feeling the pressure. Bowls a fuller delivery on middle, Noor Ahmad lofts it down to long on for a couple of runs. Noor Ahmad keeps the strike but the SIREN GOES OFF ONCE AGAIN. It's a FREE HIT...
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 19.4: Kagiso Rabada to Noor Ahmad, No ball!

Commentary.Commentary: Finally, a dot ball. Full and straight, tailing in, dabbed down to long on for a dot ball.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 19.3: Kagiso Rabada to Noor Ahmad, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! From having the game in hand, South Africa are now on the brink of throwing it all away. Noor Ahmad has hit a couple of unbelievable sixes. Short of a length and over middle, Noor hangs back, makes a bit of room by moving to the leg side and wallops the pull over deep square leg for a biggie. 5 needed now off 4 balls.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 19.2: Kagiso Rabada to Noor Ahmad, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: PUT DOWN! But it was a Free Hit anyway. Pitched up fuller around off, Noor Ahmad stays put and launches it down to long off where Marco Jansen spills it. No run is taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 19.1: Kagiso Rabada to Noor Ahmad, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Pressure on KG! Full and sliding down the leg side. Noor Ahmad looks to flick but misses. The Free-Hit continues...
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 19.1: Kagiso Rabada to Noor Ahmad, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: NO BALL! What drama! Oh, boy! Who wrote the script? This is full and around off, Ahmad looks to flick it away but miscues his shot as it was a slower delivery. It goes off the top edge to cover where the fielder takes the catch. But the SIREN GOES OFF and it's called a No Ball. Free Hit coming up....
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 19.1: Kagiso Rabada to Noor Ahmad, No ball!

Commentary.Commentary: Fazalhaq Farooqi is the last batter in for Afghanistan. Kagiso Rabada to bowl the final over. 13 needed off the final over.

OUT! MUJEEB UR RAHMAN IS RUN OUT! This should settle the nerves in the Proteas dugout! This is full and around off, in the blockhole. Ahmad squeezes it out to the left of Jansen, around the deck. A mix-up as both the batters are stranded, looking for a single. Meanwhile, Marco Jansen runs across, picks up and hits the bullseye at the batter's end.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 18.6: Marco Jansen to Noor Ahmad, OUT! run out (Marco Jansen).

Commentary.Commentary: Overpitched, outside off. Ahmad fails to get underneath and digs it out to cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 18.5: Marco Jansen to Noor Ahmad, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Out of nowhere! Well, we are not done yet because Ahmad has different ideas. In the slot, a touch fuller and touch wider. Noor Ahmad steps inside the line and thumps it down the ground to long on for a six.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 18.4: Marco Jansen to Noor Ahmad, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: South Africa are holding on to all the crucial catches and that probably is going to be the difference in the end. With that said, Noor Ahmad walks out to bat now. 19 needed off 9 balls.

OUT! KHAN GOES! This could be the game for the Proteas! Marco Jansen bowls a nice deceptive slower delivery, wide of the hitting arc of Khan, fuller delivery. Rashid Khan throws his blade and drags his shot. A nothing shot, actually and hits it down the ground. David Miller covers a lot of ground from long on. He runs to his left, slides and takes a brilliant catch. South Africa keeping their standards high in the field. A valiant 20 off 12 for Rashid.
Commentary.Howout: c David Miller b Marco Jansen
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 18.3: Marco Jansen to Rashid Khan, OUT! c David Miller b Marco Jansen.

Commentary.Commentary: George Linde puts in a solid effort as he runs back to chase the ball but in the process, he might have pulled his hamstring. Shorter delivery, outside off, Rashid Khan plays his famous ramp shot but slices it behind point. George Linde runs back from backward point, slides in the deep and keeps it down to two.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 18.2: Marco Jansen to Rashid Khan, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Excellent commitment in the deep from George Linde. However, he seems to have gotten his knee stuck in the turf. He will now hobble off the pitch and the physio will tend to him.
WIDE! Tries the slower ball but delivers it well over the tramline outside off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 18.2: Marco Jansen to Rashid Khan, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Marco Jansen bowls into the pitch, touch short and on off, Khan flat-bats it down the ground to long off for a brace.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 18.1: Marco Jansen to Rashid Khan, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: The pressure is on. Everything rests on the shoulders of skipper Rashid Khan. Marco Jansen (3-0-31-0) is back on to bowl the 19th over. 24 needed off 12 balls.
On a good length and on middle, Mujeeb Ur Rahman solidly blocks.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 17.6: Lungi Ngidi to Mujeeb Ur Rahman, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: The next batter is in. It is Mujeeb Ur Rahman in at number 9.

OUT! TAKEN! Wonderful catch from Stubbs. Should we even call this a stunner? These players are making it look so easy nowadays. Lungi Ngidi misses his mark and bowls a slower delivery in the slot. Azmatullah Omarzai launches it down to long on but fails to power it much. Omarzai thought he cleared the fence but Tristan Stubbs holds his nerves at the edge of the boundary line, picks up the catch over his head but just as he was losing his balance, he lobs it up, goes beyond the boundary and then gets back in to collect the catch again. It's fair in the replays. 24 needed off 13 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Tristan Stubbs b Lungi Ngidi
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 17.5: Lungi Ngidi to Azmatullah Omarzai, OUT! c Tristan Stubbs b Lungi Ngidi.

Commentary.Commentary: Is that a fair catch? Tristan Stubbs is very confident and the Proteas are celebrating. What an occasion to pull off something spectacular and the third umpire confirms that it is a fair catch. OUT!
An off-cutter, pings off the surface as Ngidi bowls in the deck. Khan fends it away to square leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 17.4: Lungi Ngidi to Rashid Khan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Much better from Ngidi! A wide yorker, outside off, removes all the pace off it. Rashid Khan tries to guide it away but misses.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 17.3: Lungi Ngidi to Rashid Khan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: A full toss, dipping onto the batter on middle, this is flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 17.2: Lungi Ngidi to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nicely picked! Lungi Ngidi spills out a low full toss, drifting on the pads. Omarzai helps it away to the left of the diving short fine leg fielder. No chance for the man in the deep as well. A boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 17.1: Lungi Ngidi to Azmatullah Omarzai, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Bowling change. Who will it be? Lungi Ngidi or Marco Jansen? It will be Ngidi to bowl the 18th. 30 needed off 18 deliveries.
Bowls a bumper, outside off and into the surface. Omarzai gets on top and taps it to point to keep the strike. 11 from the over, 30 needed off 3 overs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 16.6: Kagiso Rabada to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Too full and angling on middle, Khan turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 16.5: Kagiso Rabada to Rashid Khan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Cheeky, very cheeky! A peach of a yorker from Rabada, around off. Nothing wrong with the delivery but Khan shows his smartness. He bends down and guides it fine of short third for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 16.4: Kagiso Rabada to Rashid Khan, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Serves it full, pace-off and outside off. Khan knocks it to cover and denies the run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 16.3: Kagiso Rabada to Rashid Khan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Khan has picked the bones out of it. Short of a good length slower delivery and around off, lands in front of Khan, who pulls it powerfully, flat to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 16.2: Kagiso Rabada to Rashid Khan, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: A good length delivery, around off, this is punched through covers for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 16.1: Kagiso Rabada to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Just 4 overs to go now and this game is turning into a real humdinger of a contest. 41 needed off 24 balls and Kagiso Rabada (2-0-15-1) is back into the attack. He'll likely bowl the 17th and the 19th over.
Pushes it full and on leg, Omarzai gets inside the line as he tracks back and work it down to long off for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 15.6: George Linde to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and on top of off, Khan cuts it late and to the right of the big Jansen, who dives across and keeps it down to one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 15.5: George Linde to Rashid Khan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Khan shows how to play it! Fuller delivery, down leg, no turn this time and Rashid Khan nicely sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 15.4: George Linde to Rashid Khan, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Oh, just out of Linde's reach! Linde bowls in the rough from over the wicket. Omarzai is tempted to whip it away as he leans in, but miscues it to the left of the bowler. George Linde puts in a full stretched dive to his left, but the ball is just out of his reach.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 15.3: George Linde to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Tosses it up, full and outside off. Khan punches it through covers for a single to get off the mark.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 15.2: George Linde to Rashid Khan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: What a turnaround for George Linde! Rashid Khan is now in at number 8 for Afghanistan.

OUT! STRAIGHT UP AND GONE! George Linde wasn't having a good day so far but this wicket will help his team. Linde comes over the wicket and pitches it up on leg, Nabi's eyes lit up as he quickly gets on his knee to slog-sweep but the ball darts in sharply and takes the top edge. High up and to cover it goes, where Aiden Markram takes the skier. 'Mr President' goes for just 5 runs to his name. 49 needed off 29 now.
Commentary.Howout: c Aiden Markram b George Linde
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 15.1: George Linde to Mohammad Nabi, OUT! c Aiden Markram b George Linde.

Commentary.Commentary: 49 needed off the last 30 balls and the required rate is now under 10 runs an over. Afghanistan will feel they are ahead right now. With that said, George Linde is brought back into the attack. He's gone for 31 runs so far in his two overs. This could be make or break for the Proteas.

FOUR! An expensive over from Marco Jansen! This is a half-volley, on the fifth stump. Azmatullah Omarzai rocks back and smokes it over the extra cover fielder. The ball bounces off into the sweeper cover fence and Omarzai gets his second boundary of the inning.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 14.6: Marco Jansen to Azmatullah Omarzai, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, outside off, Azmatullah Omarzai frees his arms and slaps it toward right of deep cover for a couple of runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 14.5: Marco Jansen to Azmatullah Omarzai, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Easy pickings for Azmatullah Omarzai! This is a slower one and fuller, on leg. Azmatullah Omarzai glances it wide of Kagiso Rabada, in the short fine leg region, and the ball races away to the fence for four runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 14.4: Marco Jansen to Azmatullah Omarzai, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: On a fuller length, around the pads, Mohammad Nabi flicks it to the short fine leg fielder and gets a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 14.3: Marco Jansen to Mohammad Nabi, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, just outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai stands tall and spanks it toward long off for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 14.2: Marco Jansen to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! Back of a length, pitching on off and angling it away from the right-hander. Azmatullah Omarzai looks to poke it away but gets beaten.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 14.1: Marco Jansen to Azmatullah Omarzai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: DRINKS! Pheww! Everyone needs a breather as a lot has happened in the last few overs. South Africa have picked the big wicket of Rahmanullah Gurbaz. Things have heated up in the middle between Nabi and Ngidi, not removing his wristband. Afghanistan need 61 runs in 36 balls. Hard to call whose game it is right now. We'll sit back and let the final phase unfold.
On a length, on off, Azmatullah Omarzai rolls his wrists and flicks it to square leg to rotate the strike. A tidy over from Ngidi, only six runs from it!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 13.6: Lungi Ngidi to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Yorker now, on off and middle, Mohammad Nabi digs it toward square leg and gets a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 13.5: Lungi Ngidi to Mohammad Nabi, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, angling in, on off and middle. Mohammad Nabi tries to nudge it to mid on, but gets nicked on the inside edge. The ball rolls to the short fine leg region and Omarzai from the bowler's end shouts 'NO' to Nabi.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 13.4: Lungi Ngidi to Mohammad Nabi, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, angling in, down the leg side. Azmatullah Omarzai flicks it to short fine leg and gets a quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 13.3: Lungi Ngidi to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Another slower one, on a hard length, on off, Nabi tucks it to square leg and gets across.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 13.2: Lungi Ngidi to Mohammad Nabi, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Lungi Ngidi starts off with a slower yorker, on off. Mohammad Nabi tucks it with soft hands to the vacant square leg region and gets a couple of runs between the sticks.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 13.1: Lungi Ngidi to Mohammad Nabi, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Halt! Mohammad Nabi is having a heated argument with the umpires as he wants Lungi Ngidi to remove his wristband. It's pale yellowish in colour and Nabi deems it's not helping him see the ball. Ngidi is not having any of it, and neither is the Proteas skipper, who stands up for the argument. The wristband stays.
Tossed up, on off, Azmatullah Omarzai drives it to cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 12.6: Keshav Maharaj to Azmatullah Omarzai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fourth time in the game we have seen a double-wicket over. Two from each side. Mr President from Afghanistan, Mohammad Nabi is the next batter in.

OUT! DARWISH RASOOLI IS RUN OUT! Oh, that is very ordinary running between the wickets. Keshav Maharaj bowls it flat and a bit full outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai stays low and dabs it to the left of point. The batters set off for the single but Azmat is ball-watching and realizes that there is no run on offer, and he turns back. Rasooli, however, is nearly at the keeper's end himself and the fielder throws it back to the wrong end. Quinton de Kock keeps his cool and throws the ball back to the bowler as Rasooli tries to scamper back. The dive is put in but the bails are dislodged and with the smart replay in place, the umpire raises his finger. Afghanistan are now 121/5, needing 67 off 43 balls.
Commentary.Howout: run out (Quinton de Kock / Keshav Maharaj)
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 12.5: Keshav Maharaj to Azmatullah Omarzai, OUT! run out (Quinton de Kock / Keshav Maharaj).

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter one, darted in towards middle stump, Azmatullah Omarzai stays back and blocks it off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 12.4: Keshav Maharaj to Azmatullah Omarzai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Rahmanullah Gurbaz needs to be dragged off the middle as he can't believe he has picked the fielder. A momentum-shifting wicket. Azmatullah Omarzai replaces Rahmanullah Gurbaz.

OUT! TAKEN! Keshav Maharaj has got the big fish and the Proteas are all pumped up. This is tossed up, fuller, outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz crouches low and attempts to lash it over the sweeper cover, but ends up slicing it away to short third. George Linde dives to his left and takes a superb catch. Credit to the bowler who sucked Gurbaz into playing the big shot with the floater. The magnificent knock of Rahmanullah Gurbaz (84 off 42) has come to an end, and surely the Proteas will be happy to see his back. Afghanistan are now 121/4, needing 67 off 45 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c George Linde b Keshav Maharaj
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 12.3: Keshav Maharaj to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, OUT! c George Linde b Keshav Maharaj.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! CLUBBED AWAY! Pitches it up, does Maharaj, just outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets down on his knee and slogs it across the line over the long on region. Marco Jansen is the man patrolling the area, who leaps up high but the ball manages to escape the fingertips of the fielder.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 12.2: Keshav Maharaj to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off, Darwish Rasooli slaps it toward the right of point for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 12.1: Keshav Maharaj to Darwish Rasooli, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Just over! This is bowled full and flat around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz is quick to lunge across and get inside the line. He then sweeps it hard and flat, nailing it over the leaping fielder at deep backward square leg for a biggie. 14 off Markram's first over and the gamble hasn't paid off for South Africa.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 11.6: Aiden Markram to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Full and straight, swept away firmly to deep square leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 11.5: Aiden Markram to Darwish Rasooli, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Full and fired in at the toes, swept away straight to short fine leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 11.4: Aiden Markram to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Default_Commentary: 11.3: Aiden Markram to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Four!

Commentary.Default_Commentary: 11.2: Aiden Markram to Darwish Rasooli, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Begins with an in-drifter and floats it on the pads, Gurbaz tucks it wide of short fine leg and picks up a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 11.1: Aiden Markram to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Aiden Markram brings himself into the attack.
Fired in, full and wide outside off, Gurbaz squeezes it behind point for a single. The 100 is now up for Afghanistan as well.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.6: Keshav Maharaj to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Floated up, around off, Rasooli flat-bats it down to long off and turns the strike over.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.5: Keshav Maharaj to Darwish Rasooli, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Dragged length, at the stumps, worked away off the back foot and through mid-wicket for a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.4: Keshav Maharaj to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and outside off again, Rasooli throws his hands at it and slices it down to deep cover-point for just another single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.3: Keshav Maharaj to Darwish Rasooli, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker one, full and wide, slides on with the arm. Gurbaz waits back and gets low before dabbing it down to short third for a quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.2: Keshav Maharaj to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Floated up, wide outside off, goes straight on and Gurbaz lets it be. Wide called.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.2: Keshav Maharaj to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Flat and a bit fuller outside off, Rasooli reaches out and slaps it to deep point for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 10.1: Keshav Maharaj to Darwish Rasooli, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: We have reached the halfway point in the second inning. Afghanistan have lost three of their batters and scored 93 runs on the board so far. Rahmanullah Gurbaz is leading the batting unit from the moment he stepped at the crease and he also notched up his fourth T20 World Cup half-century. They need 95 more runs off 60 balls in this chase.
The call is for two and this time, they do get it. Good length outside off, hit on the up and to the right of sweeper cover for a brace. Afghanistan are 93/3 after 10 overs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 9.6: Marco Jansen to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! That's eye-catching strokeplay from Gurbaz. Full and wide outside off, Gurbaz staps across to the off side, goes on one knee and lifts it over covers for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 9.5: Marco Jansen to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Full, darted in at the toes. Darwish Rasooli gets the front leg out of the way and jams it wide of square leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 9.4: Marco Jansen to Darwish Rasooli, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a good length, angling across off, Rasooli blocks it off.

Too short and too wide, slower in the air. DR flashes his blade to deep point and picks up a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.6: Keshav Maharaj to Darwish Rasooli, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Quick single! A bit too full, outside off, Gurbaz crunches it to cover, towards Aiden Markram and runs across.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.5: Keshav Maharaj to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.1: Keshav Maharaj to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hesitation again, but the batters are safe! Fuller delivery on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz nudges it with soft hands to mid-wicket and rings for two. George Linde runs across and slides. He misfields but Gurbaz doesn't want to risk another wicket and settles down.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.6: George Linde to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.5: George Linde to Darwish Rasooli, 1 run.

Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.4: George Linde to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Leg bye.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Fifty for Rahmanullah Gurbaz! His fourth T20 World Cup half-century. What a shot this is. Not that short, Linde gives a lot of width outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets underneath the ball and slashes it flat and over extra cover for a six. Gurbaz raises his bat and gestures towards the dugout, not to worry, as if to say he has it all under control. That kind of body language speaks volumes about confidence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.3: George Linde to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Linde slows up the pace and gives some air, this is on middle, RG taps it on the deck.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.2: George Linde to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bowling change? Yes, spin from both ends. George Linde (1-0-17-0) is back on.

Commentary.Commentary: Done with the first 6 overs. Afghanistan are keeping up with the required rate but have already lost 3 wickets. Also, Keshav Maharaj is now brought into the attack.

A dot to finish off a positive over from Kagiso Rabada! Short of a length, just outside off, Darwish Rasooli attempts a pull shot but misses the connection. 5 runs and a wicket from it. 56/3 in the Powerplay.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, angling in, around leg. Darwish Rasooli flicks it from the inner half of his bat to the right of the short mid-wicket fielder. The deep square leg fielder moves to his left and cuts it to three runs.

Commentary.Commentary: DRINKS! From 51/0, Afghanistan have slipped to 52/3 in the blink of an eye. The variations from the Proteas seamers have caused immense trouble to the Asian team. Afghanistan are still on track, they just need to absorb some pressure and build a big partnership, while South Africa will like to carry this momentum into the consolidation phase and hope their spinners can cause more trouble. Darwish Rasooli is the next batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Afghanistan lose their third wicket in the space of seven balls, and oh boy, what a take that is from Marco Jansen. Kagiso Rabada bowls this one on a good length, around the thigh pad of the batter. Sediqullah Atal gets inside the line and looks to tickle it but the ball flies toward the left of Marco Jansen in the short fine leg region, who dives and takes a spectacular catch. Gurbaz is left stranded at the other end right now, with wickets falling left, right and center.
Commentary.Howout: c Marco Jansen b Kagiso Rabada
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Kagiso Rabada to Sediqullah Atal, OUT! c Marco Jansen b Kagiso Rabada.

Commentary.Commentary: Yorker, on leg. Rahmanullah Gurbaz opens his stance, but ends up jamming it to backward point and gets a one run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Kagiso Rabada to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitches it up, does Ngidi, outside off, Sediqullah Atal leans towards the delivery and defends it to the off side.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Lungi Ngidi to Sediqullah Atal, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Slower and much fuller, wide outside off, Sediqullah Atal jams it from the outer half of his bat to deep third for no runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Lungi Ngidi to Sediqullah Atal, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: One brings two. An inspiring change from Aiden Markram has brought him two wickets. Sediqullah Atal comes in for Gulbadin Naib.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! What a comeback over from Lungi Ngidi. Another slower ball, Ngidi goes wider on the crease and pitches it up on a nagging length around middle. Gulbadin Naib misreads the pace completely and leans on to push at it. The ball holds in the deck and lobs off the face of the blade. Ngidi takes a brilliant diving catch to his right in the follow-through, and Naib has to walk back after a two-ball duck.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Lungi Ngidi to Gulbadin Naib, OUT! c & b Lungi Ngidi.

Commentary.Commentary: Ngidi has tried it again. Slower one, full and dips on the batter but this one just slips down leg. Gulbadin Naib gets inside the line to flick but misses and it is given as a fair delivery.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Lungi Ngidi to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: The 51-run opening stand is broken. Gulbadin Naib comes in and replaces Ibrahim Zadran.

OUT! CASTLED! The Proteas get their first breakthrough, and it's Lungi Ngidi who breaks this dangerous-looking partnership. This is a bit slower and fuller, pitching just outside off and shaping back in. Ibrahim Zadran charges down the deck to flick it with power towards the leg side, but misses and the ball dips and crashes into the stumps. Ibrahim Zadran departs, scoring 12 off 10 balls.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Lungi Ngidi to Ibrahim Zadran, OUT! b Lungi Ngidi.

Commentary.Commentary: Slower low full toss, on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz nudges it to the right of the mid on fielder and gets across for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Lungi Ngidi to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Oh, this is brilliant hitting from the Afghan openers and the 50 is already up for Afghanistan. Flighted ball at the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran steps out and clobbers it over wide long on for a biggie. Zadran barely got to the pitch of the ball, still managed to generate the power.

Commentary.Commentary: An over each for the Proteas pacers so far. Time for George Linde to roll his arms now.
Another play and a miss. Full and in the channel, drawing out the drive from Zadran but the ball beats the willow once again. 10 runs off KG's first over.
